latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Full Hyperliquid perpetual futures trading with portfolio monitoring, market analysis (charts/volume via CoinGecko), automated momentum signals, position tracking, and complete risk management strategy support

raw_record.summary: Trade and monitor Hyperliquid perpetual futures. Check balances, view positions with P&L, place/cancel orders, execute market trades. Use when the user asks about Hyperliquid trading, portfolio status, crypto positions, or wants to execute trades on Hyperliquid.
